_comment: Removed a PAY_OR_DAMAGE that deals damage where the card suppresses TRIGGERS. NOT IMPLEMENTED: 'When this defends, effects don't trigger when an attack hits this chain link unless the attacking hero pays {r}' -- a trigger-suppression replacement gated on an optional payment by the OPPONENT, and nothing in the engine can suppress on-hit triggers conditionally. Also not implemented: 'can only be played from arsenal', a play-legality restriction. Dealing 1 damage instead is not an approximation of either.
